caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by several thin blue strings, set against a plain light beige background. The puppet is dressed in a loose-fitting red costume with green accents, including a green collar, cuffs, and a green band near the end of the trousers. The marionette’s costume is gathered at the elbows, waist, and knees. A round, gold-colored button is visible at the center of the collar. The puppet's face is painted with wide-open eyes, arched eyebrows, a broad red-lipped smile, rounded cheekbones with red blush, and has black hair peeking out from under a red and green striped cap. The arms are jointed wooden pieces, and both hands grip a light green horizontal rod. The legs are straight with green bands just below the knees, and the shoes are beige with dark accents. Above and to the right of the main puppet, there is an additional sketch of the puppet’s head and upper torso drawn in profile, showing the same red and green headgear and costume, and highlighting the puppet’s nose and ear in profile. The drawing uses mostly shades of red, green, beige, and touches of black. The artist's signature, "David Ramage," appears in cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Acrobat Albert
